meta.source: County BOCC department pages (6) and one county-published ArcGIS district layer (Baker); no statewide service-area layer exists
meta.not_sourced_note: Holmes: county site holmescountyfl.org is a parked stub; Taylor: county Fire & Rescue page says it supports EMS only "on an as-needed basis", EMS provider not named; Washington: county site lists no EMS department (Emergency Management only). CMS 2024 does show Holmes BOCC (Bonifay, 557 emergency transports), Washington County Ambulance (Chipley, 791, share 0.77) and none for Taylor, but a county page is still needed.

rows.ownership: county EMS (Liberty County BOCC, Community Services)
rows.transport_basis: FL DOH licence type ALS/T (states/FL_parsed.json) + CMS 2024 emergency billing; the cited page does not say "transports"
rows.evidence: Home / Community Services / Ambulance Services: "EMS Effective October 1, 2024 ... Download Copy of EMS Fee Schedule (Updated October 2024)"; office Bristol, FL.
rows.note: County ambulance department with its own fee schedule; no sentence says "transports". Transport rests on the FL DOH licence ALS/T (licence 3901) and the CMS 2024 file (County Of Liberty BOCC, Bristol: 61 emergency transports, share 1.0).

rows.ownership: county fire rescue (Baker County Board of County Commissioners)
rows.transport_basis: FL DOH licence type ALS/T (states/FL_parsed.json) + CMS 2024 emergency billing; the cited page does not say "transports"
rows.evidence: County-published ArcGIS layer "BCFR EMS & Career Fire Districts" (owner account at bakerfl.gov, last edit 2024-04-24); service description: "Map showing the districts of the Baker County Fire & Rescue EMS and Career Fire Employees". Three district polygons cover 99.8% of Baker County (District 70 73.8%, District 90 13.8%, District 50 12.3%).
rows.note: Polygons carry district numbers only, no provider field: the provider is named by the layer title/description. FL DOH licence 201 ALS/T "Baker County Fire Rescue", Macclenny. CMS 2024: County Of Baker, Macclenny, 648 emergency transports, share 1.0. Layer is 2.5 years old.
